title: metadata
description: Content of the metadata multipart part. Contains no PII values. Its exact bytes are the additional authenticated data of the encrypted pii_manifest.

document_id.description: Equals pii_manifest.document_id; joins the three parts.

delivery_id.description: Package identifier; not a request-idempotency key.

detector_version.description: Detection prompt version that produced the package.

redacted_md_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex of the exact UTF-8 bytes of the redacted_md part.

created_at.description: UTC RFC 3339; equals every manifest entry redacted_at.
